description: Closes the agent's open position in the given asset by submitting a governed reduce-only market order in the opposite direction, sized to the full position. It goes through the exact same policy engine as place_order — BLOCK and REQUIRE_APPROVAL are normal outcomes to adapt to. If there is no open position, nothing is submitted.

asset.description: Asset symbol of the position to close.

clientOrderId.description: Idempotency key. REUSE the same value when retrying this exact close; new intent = new value. Auto-generated if omitted.

name: close_position
title: Close position (Riv-governed)
